bus.via: Milwaukee Intermodal Station to Shawano WI

trips.route_note: Frequent direct IC/EIC trains run from Katowice to Kraków Główny in about 1.5 hours, then the old town is a short walk or tram ride from the station.
see: Rynek Główny and St. Mary's Basilica
trips.why: Direct IC/EIC trains take about 46 minutes and the old town is a short walk from Kraków Główny.
know: Book IC/EIC seats ahead for weekend travel
Main Market Square and Wawel are walkable from the station
Allow a full day to cover the old town and castle

trips.route_note: Regional trains and buses run directly from Katowice to Oświęcim in roughly 1 to 1.5 hours, with the Auschwitz-Birkenau memorial a short local bus or walk from the station.
trips.why: Direct regional trains reach Oświęcim in about 1h13m with the memorial a short local ride from the station.
know: Book Auschwitz-Birkenau memorial entry in advance
Allow several hours for both camps
Wear comfortable shoes for the large site

trips.tour_query: Jasna Gora day trip from Katowice
trips.why: Direct trains take about 1h4m and Jasna Góra monastery is a short walk or tram from the station.
know: Jasna Góra is an active pilgrimage site, dress respectfully
The monastery grounds are free to walk

trips.route_note: Direct IC trains run from Katowice to Wrocław Główny in about 2 to 2.5 hours, with the Market Square a short walk from the station.
see: Panorama of the Battle of Racławice
trips.why: Direct IC trains take about 1h50m and the Market Square is a short walk from Wrocław Główny.
know: Book IC seats ahead, only a few direct trains daily
Allow a full day for the Market Square and Ostrów Tumski
Check the return train times before setting out

trips.label: Bielsko-Biała
trips.route_note: Frequent regional trains and buses run from Katowice to Bielsko-Biała in about 1.5 hours, with the old town a short walk from the station.
trips.why: Regional trains take about 1h8m and the old town is a short walk from the station.
know: Trains are frequent, so no need to book far ahead
The old town and castle are compact and walkable
Good base for nearby Beskid mountain views
